study type: Quasi-experimental study with a historical, propensity-matched control group
cohort: The study included 121 paediatric patients enrolled in an ERAS pathway for cardiac surgery between October 2019 and July 2023, compared to a propensity-matched historical control group of non-ERAS patients.
finding: The ERAS pathway in paediatric cardiac surgery is feasible and safe for select low-risk patients, significantly reducing the duration of postoperative mechanical ventilation, ICU LOS, and hospital LOS without increasing risks.
followup_time: At least 30 days after surgery (for 30-day readmissions)
